info.description:
Programmatic evidencing of BRD FR-IDs against the CA.CAGM Tuum Dev tenant, per fr-evidencing-methodology-v0_2.md. One folder per FR-ID (or small cluster). Root Authorize request sets a collection-scoped {{token}} reused by every folder.

**Updated 10 Sep 2026** against the 12-file 2.44.x OpenAPI specs (account-api-v_2_44_1.json, person-api-v_2_44_0.json) — see each folder's own description for what changed and what's still open.

**Updated 11 Sep 2026:** added the FR-A3 (Account Closure with Atomic Balance Sweep) folder — a genuine new structural addition, not an edit to an existing folder, so this update needs a full-file reimport rather than a manual fragment paste (per §5's delta-delivery convention). FR-A3 is built but not yet run live; its own folder description covers open questions (unconfirmed closure statusReasonCode lookup type, no visible confirm/finish endpoint for WAITING_FOR_CLOSURE_DECISION, no confirmed link between /sweeps and the closure-time sweep mechanism).

**Updated 15 Oct 2026:** FR-A3 / FR-A5 / FR-A7 brought in line with POSTMAN_COLLECTION_STANDARDS.md (see each folder's dated note); the stray FR-A3 'Unblock the reservation/account' request was deleted; x-channel-code is now the collection variable {{channelCode}} in those three folders.

**OUT OF SCOPE for automation conversion (Standards §4) - setup/diagnostic content kept here for reference only, excluded by default:**
- FR-A3 > '0. Setup - Sweep-Leg Permit, Subtype & Closure-Reason Configuration' (9 requests)
- FR-A7 > '00 - Setup. Closure reason code (run once per tenant)' (3 requests)
- Top-level 'Account setup' folder - a near-duplicate of 'FR-A5:Pre-requisites', but do NOT delete or move it without re-pointing FR-A2: it is the only place that creates {{AccountId}}, which every FR-A2 request reads.
- FR-A2's parked 'Deactivation (INACTIVE)' sub-folder and the diagnostic steps in its '0. Pre-requisites'.

item.description:
Evidences the RTL-account-creation half of BRD FR-A1 (cagm-rtl-brd-v1_2.md): a payload creates a new RTL account, the client ID and account number are returned, and a posting immediately succeeds. Picked as the next low-hanging-fruit folder after FR-A2 (10 Sep 2026) because the CreatePerson/CreateAccount calls were already exercised successfully by Stevan in his own scratch collection — this folder ports that proven flow into the canonical evidencing collection with proper assertions, evidence-oriented descriptions, and version fixes found by checking it against the 2.44.x specs.

**NOT covered by this folder — flagged, not silently dropped:** FR-A1's other acceptance clause, "a simulated timeout queues a manual review entry," has no obvious clean-path API equivalent — it requires injecting an actual fault/timeout condition, which a normal Postman call can't do. Raise with Tuum how (or whether) this can be simulated before claiming FR-A1 fully verified; this folder only closes the account-creation/posting portion.

**Fixed 10 Sep 2026 against person-api-v_2_44_0.json and account-api-v_2_44_1.json (Stevan's original scratch collection had these wrong or unconfirmed):**
- Person read-back is `GET /api/v3/persons/{personId}` — **v3, not v2** (v2 only supports POST-create, no GET-by-id exists at v2).
- The created account's number is **not** a flat `accountNumber`/`iban` field — it's nested at `data.accountNumbers[0].accountNumber.value` (schema `AccountExtendedV2Json`), handled correctly in the test script below.
- `tenantCode` is a **required** field on `POST /api/v5/accounts` (easy to miss — it wasn't called out as required in the original draft).
- `transactionTypeCode` on the transaction-post step has **no enum in the spec** — it's a free string, and the spec explicitly says the valid list must come from a separate lookup. `EXT_DEPOSIT` below is carried over from the old POC files (tuum-poc-postman-reference-v0_2.md, a different tenant) as a plausible starting value, **not a confirmed-valid code for CA.CAGM** — if step 5 fails with an invalid-transaction-type error, that's informative (tells you EXT_DEPOSIT isn't enabled here), not a sign the account-opening flow itself is broken. See that step's own description for how to find the real list.
- Uses its own `{{personId}}`/`{{newAccountId}}` variables, distinct from FR-A2's `{{accountId}}`, so running this folder can't clobber FR-A2's target account.

**Updated 10 Sep 2026 against Tuum's actual CA.CAGM config-load files (received 26 Aug 2026, from `.../0 Configurations/Technical config files/`) — these are a stronger source than the OpenAPI specs for tenant-specific enabled values, since the specs only show the shape, not what's actually turned on for CA.CAGM:**
- `productCode: PAYMENT_ACCOUNT` — **confirmed real**, one of exactly 4 products loaded for CA.CAGM (`account-api_099_account_product.json`: PAYMENT_ACCOUNT, CURRENT_ACCOUNT, SAFEGUARDING_ACCOUNT, VIRTUAL_ACCOUNT), accountTypeCode CURRENCY, serviceProviderCode TUUM, `allowAllClassCodes: true`.
- `currencyCode: USD` — confirmed enabled. **Important constraint surfaced by this file:** CA.CAGM's supported-currencies list (`account-api_0_supported_currencies.json`) is only **USD, EUR, GBP** — don't substitute another currency into this flow without checking that file first.
- `accountClassCode: TUUM` — not itself a documented class-code value anywhere seen so far, but low-risk: PAYMENT_ACCOUNT's `allowAllClassCodes: true` means the product doesn't restrict which class-code string is accepted at creation time.
- `serviceProviderCode: TUUM` — confirmed (present in both the product config and `account-api_account_type_setup.json`, which also confirms `accountTypeSetupCode: STANDARD` is enabled for account type CURRENCY).

**Flagging back, not silently reconciling:** the tracker (v3.9, FR-E2 notes) describes a currency-list question as sent to Tanel Pappel 9 Sep 2026 and 'awaiting response' — but this supported-currencies config file is dated/received 26 Aug 2026 and already shows the answer (USD/EUR/GBP) via that exact endpoint. Either the 9 Sep message was asking about something narrower (e.g. the separate 'all eligible currencies except AED, plus USDC' business ask, which this loaded set does NOT reflect — no USDC here), or the tracker note is stale. Worth reconciling on the Claude.ai side rather than assumed here.
